news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro (CLPT) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
news.summary: Management detailed plans for 10-15 partner clinical trials to begin patient enrollment over the next 18 months and reaffirmed that the Biologics and Drug Delivery segment is expected to return to growth in Q3 2026 as new CAL preclinical services revenue ramps.

news.headline: Analysts trim ClearPoint Neuro price targets after Q2 miss and guidance cut
news.summary: Following the Q2 report, Stifel lowered its price target to $22 from $25 and Lake Street lowered its target to $25 from $30, while both maintained bullish ratings on the neuro-navigation and drug-delivery platform.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
news.summary: Q2 2026 revenue rose 18% year-over-year to $10.9 million but missed the $12.73 million consensus, with a wider adjusted loss of $0.38/share and cash falling to $29.4 million; the company cut FY2026 revenue guidance to $48-52 million from $52-56 million.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Aug 2026 slides: $500m revenue target amid Q2 miss
news.summary: Alongside the Q2 miss, ClearPoint unveiled a five-pillar strategy targeting $500 million in annual revenue built around neuro-navigation, capital equipment, biologics/drug-delivery services, focused ultrasound, and robotics/software.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Congratulates Partner Aspen Neuroscience on FDA RMAT Designation for Sasineprocel
news.summary: Biopharma partner Aspen Neuroscience received FDA Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy designation for its autologous dopaminergic cell therapy for Parkinson's disease, sasineprocel, which is delivered using ClearPoint's Navigation System and SmartFlow Cannula.

news.headline: EpilepsyGTx partners with ClearPoint Neuro to support targeted delivery of lead gene therapy in epilepsy
news.summary: EpilepsyGTx will use ClearPoint's SmartFlow Cannula and Navigation System to administer its lead gene therapy candidate EPY201 in an upcoming Phase 1/2a trial for focal refractory epilepsy, adding to ClearPoint's roster of 60+ active biopharma partners.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly results are expected roughly following the company's established cadence (Q2 reported Aug 3, 2026); exact date not yet officially announced.

catalysts.label: Biologics & Drug Delivery segment return to growth
catalysts.detail: Management guided that new ClearPoint Advanced Laboratories (CAL) preclinical services revenue should return the Biologics and Drug Delivery segment to sequential growth in Q3 2026 after a Q2 decline.

catalysts.label: First GLP preclinical study completion at CAL
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint Advanced Laboratories' first statement-of-work involving GLP preclinical services is expected to be completed in the first half of 2027.

catalysts.label: CE Mark for Navigation Software 3.x / iCT upgrades
catalysts.detail: Company product roadmap targets CE Mark certification for ClearPoint Navigation Software 3.x and iCT compatibility upgrades within 2026.

catalysts.label: Partner clinical trial enrollment wave
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint expects 10-15 biopharma partner clinical trials using its delivery systems to begin enrolling patients, with management citing potential for additional partner cell/gene therapies to reach commercial approval by end of 2027.

catalysts.label: Harmony 1.0 software and robotic platform milestones
catalysts.detail: Roadmap targets Harmony 1.0 software with sub-nuclei segmentation and continued development of the KUKA LBR-based cranial robotic platform, both showcased to surgeons in 2026 but not yet commercially launched.

pulse: ClearPoint Neuro grew Q2 2026 revenue 18% to $10.9 million but missed consensus estimates and posted a wider net loss, prompting a cut to FY2026 revenue guidance (to $48-52 million) and a sharp post-earnings selloff with price-target reductions from Stifel and Lake Street. The company is leaning into a longer-term $500 million five-pillar growth vision anchored on its neuro-navigation and capital equipment platform, the newly integrated IRRAflow portfolio, its ClearPoint Advanced Laboratories preclinical services unit, and a network of 60+ biopharma partners (recent additions include EpilepsyGTx, alongside positive regulatory news from partner Aspen Neuroscience) using its SmartFlow/Navigation systems for cell and gene therapy delivery to the brain. Near-term the narrative is dominated by execution risk and cash burn (cash fell to $29.4 million in H1 2026) set against a still-unrealized, multi-year biologics and drug-delivery opportunity.
